d: We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive AML Consultant to join our Compliance Team. The ideal candidate should have 1–2 years of practical experience in UAE Designated Non-Financial Businesses and Professions (DNFBPs), with a sound understanding of UAE AML/CFT regulations and regulatory compliance requirements.

The candidate will be responsible for assisting clients in implementing and maintaining AML compliance frameworks, conducting risk assessments, reviewing KYC documentation, supporting regulatory inspections, and ensuring compliance with applicable UAE laws and regulatory requirements.
The role involves regular client visits, requiring the candidate to travel to client premises for compliance reviews, meetings, document verification, and inspection support.
q: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Law, or a related field.
1–2 years of relevant experience in UAE DNFBP AML compliance.
Practical knowledge of UAE AML/CFT regulatory requirements applicable to DNFBPs.
Familiarity with goAML registration, KYC/CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, PEP screening, and EWRA.
Understanding of regulatory inspection requirements and AML documentation standards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Ability to manage multiple client assignments and meet deadlines.
Experience working with accounting firms, corporate service providers, real estate brokers, dealers in precious metals and stones, or other DNFBP sectors.
Familiarity with UAE regulatory authorities and relevant free zone compliance requirements.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Ability to conduct independent client visits and communicate effectively with business owners and client representatives.
Willingness to travel within the UAE for client meetings and compliance assignments.
Professional attitude, problem-solving ability, and a strong sense of responsibility.
Client visits are mandatory as part of the role.
The candidate must be willing and able to travel to client premises across the UAE as required.
Candidates must be comfortable handling multiple client portfolios and working in a deadline-driven environment.
r: Assist clients in understanding and complying with applicable UAE AML/CFT laws, regulations, and regulatory guidelines.
Support the preparation, review, and implementation of AML/CFT policies, controls, and procedures.
Assist clients with goAML registration and related regulatory requirements.
Monitor regulatory updates and communicate relevant compliance requirements to clients.
Know Your Customer (KYC) and Customer Due Diligence
Collect, verify, and review KYC documents for individual and corporate clients.
Conduct Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), where applicable.
Review Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO), ownership structures, source of funds, and source of wealth documentation.
Conduct sanctions, Politically Exposed Person (PEP), and adverse media screening.
Identify missing documents, inconsistencies, and potential red flags and coordinate with clients for resolution.
Assist in preparing and updating AML Policy & Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessments (EWRA).
Assess client risk exposure based on business activities, customer profiles, geographical risks, and delivery channels.
Support the development of risk mitigation measures and compliance action plans.
Transaction Monitoring and Suspicious Activity Reporting
Review client transactions and identify unusual or potentially suspicious activities.
Identify AML/CFT red flags and escalate concerns to the appropriate compliance officer.
Assist in maintaining transaction monitoring records and documenting investigation outcomes.
Support the preparation and filing of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) or other applicable reports under the guidance of the designated compliance officer.
Conduct regular client visits to review AML compliance documentation and assess implementation.
Assist clients in preparing for regulatory inspections and compliance reviews.
Identify gaps in AML documentation and recommend corrective actions.
Attend client meetings and support communication with relevant regulatory authorities, where authorized.
Follow up on outstanding compliance requirements and ensure timely completion of action items.
Maintain accurate AML compliance records, registers, and supporting documentation.
Prepare compliance review reports, gap assessment reports, and remediation plans.
Assist in preparing periodic AML compliance reports and management updates.
Ensure documentation is maintained in an organized and inspection-ready format.
Assist in delivering AML/CFT awareness and training sessions to clients.
Explain applicable compliance requirements and documentation needs to clients in a clear and professional manner.
Coordinate with internal teams and client representatives to ensure timely completion of compliance deliverables.

d: Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.

QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.

QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.

Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
